title: The supervisor exhausts its round budget
intent: Pin the supervisor's loop bound of 12 and its onExhausted target: a run that never converges ends at graceful_failure rather than spinning.

input.featureRequest: Keep improving the config layer until it is perfect.

artifact.detail: The run stopped at supervisor: supervisorRounds exhausted after 12 rounds.

expected.notes: The supervisor's budget is the outermost bound in the graph: 12 rounds, then graceful_failure. Without it an ambiguous request has no terminating condition at all.
